scores.claim_text: USG = 18% of FY2025 revenue (~$813M); split ~50/50 between communication services and D&AT segments.
supports: usaspending confirms VIASAT INC has 663 DoD awards totaling $1.43B and INMARSAT GOVERNMENT INC has 1,929 DoD awards totaling $724M (cumulative). Top awards (AMSS III $476M, BFT2 warranties $136M, TTNT $77M, CONUS L-band $226M) confirm real, sustained DoD revenue base supporting the 18% concentration claim.
scores.M_value: usaspending: VIASAT 663 awards / $1.43B + INMARSAT 724M; pentagon_jbook contractor lookup: NOT_FOUND (corpus does not index Viasat as primary contractor — coverage gap, not a red flag).
scores.interpretation: USG revenue concentration claim is corroborated by past awards. Forward J-Book contractor-index does not list Viasat, but that is a corpus coverage gap (heuristic 7). PASS.

scores.claim_text: Government satcom services revenue grew to $754.6M FY25 from $596.8M FY24 (+26% YoY).
supports: Commercial SATCOM PE 1206445SF is FUNDED_STEADY at $132M FY26 (vs $134M FY25, $69M FY24) — i.e. doubled FY24->FY25 then held. The Pentagon's forward demand for commercial SATCOM integration into DoD networks is intact in the FY26 J-Book.
scores.interpretation: Forward Pentagon demand for commercial SATCOM is steady-to-slightly-down (-2%); Viasat's segment +26% comes from multiple buyers (Inmarsat L-band govt contracts also material). No divergence. PASS.

scores.claim_text: D&AT segment FY25 $1.221B composed of infosec/cyber $325M, space/mission $305M, tactical networking $320M, adv tech $68M.
supports: usaspending confirms $1.43B Viasat + $724M Inmarsat DoD obligations historically; the named D&AT product lines correspond to real DoD purchase lines (AMSS, BFT2 Blue Force Tracking, TTNT, L-band SATCOM).

scores.claim_text: Tactical networking products +58% YoY ($320M FY25 vs $202M FY24) — continuing growth post Link-16 TDL divestiture to L3Harris.
supports: C2ISR Tactical Data Link PE 0207448F = UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR. History: FY24 $0 → FY25 $3.5M → FY26 $0. The Air Force RDT&E line for the only J-Book-corpus 'tactical data link' PE is zeroed in FY26. Viasat's narrative implies sustained tactical networking growth without naming a specific PE; the closest named PE in our corpus shows no FY26 R&D funding. However Viasat divested Link-16 TDL to L3Harris in Jan 2023, so legacy TDL exposure largely transferred — and 'tactical networking' for Viasat now includes TTNT, BFT, modem/waveform IP licensing, not just C2ISR TDL.
scores.M_value: PE 0207448F UNFUNDED_THIS_YEAR (cutoff 2026); usaspending shows $77M TTNT spectrum relocation award (legacy, pre-cutoff) and $136M BFT2 warranties — past awards real, forward R&D PE zeroed.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 2 materiality: company does not explicitly tie revenue to PE 0207448F; the +58% growth claim is partially attributable to Inmarsat integration and BFT/TTNT IDIQs — but the closest named R&D PE is unfunded, meaning forward dev pipeline for that specific line is dry. Heuristic 6: usaspending shows past obligations real → past revenue real but forward pipeline narrow for this exact PE. Downgrade from SEVERE to MODERATE because the company does not name the PE and divestiture mitigates direct exposure.

scores.claim_text: Space and mission systems products $305M FY25; positioning into protected MILSATCOM/strategic SATCOM space programs.
supports: Cumulative FY26 forward Space Force protected-SATCOM funding ~$1.92B — strong forward demand for ground/terminal/payload integration that Viasat's space & mission systems serves.
scores.M_value: PTES FY26 $114.4M, PTS FY26 $571.9M, ESS FY26 $1,229.9M — all FUNDED_GROWING.
scores.interpretation: Pentagon's forward J-Book confirms aggressive growth in exactly the protected MILSATCOM line items Viasat positions space/mission systems to serve. PASS.

scores.claim_text: Backbone protected/wideband space programs (implicit AEHF, WGS, Polar MILSATCOM) underpinning govt SATCOM and D&AT space lines.
supports: Advanced EHF MILSATCOM (PE 1206431SF) = FUNDED_GROWING ($3.9M → $1.0M → $13.8M, sustainment R&D).
Polar MILSATCOM (PE 1206432SF) = UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS ($75M FY24 → $0 FY25 → $0 FY26). Two consecutive years zeroed in the FY26 J-Book — exactly the canonical divergence pattern.
scores.M_value: Polar MILSATCOM UNFUNDED_TWO_PLUS_YEARS; AEHF + WGS continuing in sustainment.
scores.interpretation: Heuristic 2 (materiality): Viasat does not explicitly name Polar MILSATCOM as a revenue line; the J-Book corpus shows no replacement_program for PE 1206432SF (no umbrella reorg flag). The disappearance is a real forward-pipeline negative for any terminal/ground vendor exposed to polar coverage, but Viasat's exposure is one of several MILSATCOM lines (AEHF + WGS continue, PTS/PTES/ESS growing). Heuristic 2 downgrade from RED_FLAG to MODERATE: narrative-load-bearing for SATCOM portfolio but not the dominant line.
